# Prachi Fulfagar — Vastu, Palmistry & Vedic Astrology

> Award-winning consultant offering Vastu Shastra, Palmistry and Vedic Astrology consultations. Based in Maharashtra, India with offices in Mumbai, Pune, Nashik and Kopargaon. Serves 5,000+ clients across India and internationally (UAE, UK, USA, Singapore, Australia) for 20+ years.

## About

Prachi Fulfagar is an internationally recognised consultant in three integrated disciplines: Vastu Shastra (spatial energy), Palmistry (personal patterns) and Vedic Astrology (timing). Her practice is distinctive for combining all three so that corrections work with the person, not just the space. Honours include the Indo-Thailand Jyotish Puraskar, the Indo-Thailand Vastu Brihaspati Award, the International Astro Purohit Award, the Certified Medical Astrological Proficiency, and an honorary doctorate from Thailand.
